blocks.html:
Retrieve all potential values for promotion rules and target and buy rules based on the specified rule attribute and type.
For example, if you provide the ID of the `currency_code` rule attribute, and set `rule_type` to rules,
a list of currencies are retrieved in label-value pairs.

This method sends a request to the
[List Rule Values API Route](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#promotions\_getpromotionsrulevalueoptionsrule\_typerule\_attribute\_id)

types.name: ruleType
types.description: The type of rules to retrieve the values for. Can be `rules`, `buy-rules`, or `target-rules`.

types.name: ruleValue
types.description: The ID of the rule attribute to retrieve the values for.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields to retrieve in the rule values.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

children.name: limit
children.description: The maximum number of items to retrieve.

children.name: offset
children.description: The number of items to skip before retrieving the returned items.

children.name: order
children.description: The field to sort by and in which order.

children.name: with_deleted
children.description: Whether to include soft-deleted items in the results.

children.name: q
children.description: Search for a rule value by its searchable

children.name: application_method_target_type
children.description: The target type of application method to retrieve the attributes for.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: limit
children.description: The maximum number of items retrieved.

children.name: offset
children.description: The number of items to skip before retrieving the returned items.

children.name: estimate_count
children.description: The estimated count retrieved from the PostgreSQL query planner, which may be inaccurate.
